set.body:
Objective
Migrate existing canonical/MANOVA/constrained variants and expose admitted decompositions of observation tables, relations, effect forms and neural forms with explicit metric/definiteness capabilities.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements GLB-01, FND-05, FND-07, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
numerical integration; CanonicalEffectMvpa, ConstrainedCanonicalMvpa, SignedCrossRunRayleighMvpa, ManovaMvpa; admitted Multivar/Gale. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M2.03, M2.05. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. A global fit is a rich typed artifact, not a singleton ROI or CanonicalEffectMvpa parallel result hierarchy.
2. PCA/PLS/CCA-style adapters declare the object and metric decomposed; signed cross-forms do not inherit covariance/PSD guarantees.
3. Existing constrained/signed/canonical numerical and failure behavior passes independent parity fixtures on both platforms.
4. Missing general decompositions or solvers are admitted upstream; domain modules add no private eigensolver/SVD families.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaFitJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaFitJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M3.01: Integrate typed global and canonical decomposition artifacts
